name: verity
description: Real-time fact-checking and data freshness agent. Verifies claims against live sources and returns CURRENT, OUTDATED, DISPUTED or UNVERIFIABLE, with quoted sources that VERITY re-fetched from each page, a confidence tier based on that evidence, and what changed when a claim is OUTDATED. Persistent memory per caller_id (optional).

authentication.description: The hosted endpoint uses a VERITY API key (starts with pg_) from a card credit purchase at https://verity.basechainlabs.com/#get-access, sent as the X-Api-Key header. Never send a wallet private key to any hosted service. To pay per call in USDC on Base, run the npm package locally (npx verity-mcp) so your wallet key never leaves your machine.

tools.name: verity_verify
tools.description: Verify a claim or URL against live sources. Returns verdict, evidence-based confidence tier, quoted sources, and what changed if OUTDATED. 0.10 USDC.

tools.name: verity_deep_check
tools.description: Uses deeper search and more source types for high-stakes claims. Confidence still depends on the evidence found. 0.50 USDC.

tools.name: verity_batch
tools.description: Verify up to 10 claims in one call. For content audits and pipelines. 0.75 USDC.

tools.name: verity_agent
tools.description: Natural language fact-checking. 'Is this still true?' VERITY selects the right strategy. 0.10 USDC.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check your remaining VERITY credit balance. Costs 1 credit.

prompts.name: verify-claim
prompts.description: Verify a specific claim against live web sources

prompts.name: check-url
prompts.description: Check if a URL's content is still current

prompts.name: content-audit
prompts.description: Audit content for outdated or disputed claims

prompts.name: freshness-check
prompts.description: Check how current a topic or data point is
